2017: A dangerous leak in GEO600’s vacuum system

On 1 August 2017 the GEO600 team noticed a sudden and surprising pressure increase inside the vacuum system. It quickly became clear that it must have developed a leak.

This is a potentially dangerous situation, as moist air rushing in would interrupt measurements for many, many months. The team quickly found the leak and was able to temporarily fix it.

Read more about the exciting story and how one team member was able to save the day by closing the leak with his finger: short overview at https://www.geo600.org/77883/august-2017 and the full story in the @LIGO@scicomm.xyz Magazine at https://www.aei.mpg.de/1207055/LIGO-magazine-issue16v2.pdf (PDF, page 20 and following).
